# DrinksHarbour

> DrinksHarbour is an online beverage marketplace based in Abuja, Nigeria, connecting customers with independent beverage businesses. Discover and compare wines, whisky, other spirits, beers, soft drinks and non-alcoholic drinks.

This file describes the main DrinksHarbour marketplace at https://www.drinksharbour.com/.
Participating businesses offer beverages from a shared product catalogue through their own stores. A product may have offers from multiple businesses, with different prices, sizes and availability. Public pages may call these businesses stores, sellers or vendors; the platform calls them tenants.

Use current product and store pages for selling prices, bottle sizes, stock and seller availability. Compare the selected size, quantity and seller before quoting an offer. Prices are primarily in Nigerian Naira (NGN, ₦); checkout confirms the order total and delivery fee. Availability and promotions can change.

Product details may include alcohol by volume (ABV), volume, origin and tasting notes. ABV is a percentage; bottle volume is a separate measurement. The published delivery policy requires recipients of alcoholic orders to be aged 18 or over and show valid identification.

For delivery coverage, estimates, returns and refunds, consult the relevant pages below. Use the contact page for order-specific questions, damaged deliveries and bulk enquiries. This overview contains no customer account or order information.

## Browse drinks

- [Marketplace](https://www.drinksharbour.com/): Main storefront and featured beverages.
- [Shop](https://www.drinksharbour.com/shop): Browse and filter available drinks.
- [Product catalogue](https://www.drinksharbour.com/catalogue): Alphabetical product directory; follow product links for current offers and bottle details.
- [Categories](https://www.drinksharbour.com/categories): Browse beverage categories.
- [Brands](https://www.drinksharbour.com/brands): Browse drinks by brand.
- [Deals](https://www.drinksharbour.com/deals): Current promotions; consult product pages for current offer details.
- [Stores](https://www.drinksharbour.com/vendors): Find participating beverage businesses and their public storefronts.

## Delivery

- [Shipping information](https://www.drinksharbour.com/shipping-info): Delivery zones, conditions, fees and age-verification policy; confirm the fee for an address at checkout.
- [Abuja and FCT delivery](https://www.drinksharbour.com/delivery/abuja): Local delivery information for Abuja, Gwagwalada, Kuje, Bwari and Kubwa; check the available delivery window at checkout.
- [Lagos delivery](https://www.drinksharbour.com/delivery/lagos): Information about deliveries to Lagos from Abuja; consult checkout for the current estimate and fee.

## Customer information

- [About DrinksHarbour](https://www.drinksharbour.com/about): Marketplace background and mission.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.drinksharbour.com/faqs): Answers about ordering, delivery, accounts and products.
- [Returns](https://www.drinksharbour.com/returns): Return eligibility, damaged or incorrect items, required evidence and refund process.
- [Contact and support](https://www.drinksharbour.com/contact): Current support channels and enquiry form for orders, delivery, products, returns and business partnerships.

## For beverage businesses

- [Sell on DrinksHarbour](https://www.drinksharbour.com/vendors/register): Business onboarding, public subscription plans and features for managing inventory, sales and a branded storefront; consult this page for current plan details.
- [Vendor pricing (machine-readable)](https://www.drinksharbour.com/pricing.md): Subscription plans, listing and staff limits, marketplace commission, add-ons and free trial for beverage businesses.
